definition: Yonatan Belinkov is a computer scientist who works on natural language processing, machine learning and artificial intelligence.
details: He is an associate professor in the Henry and Marilyn Taub Faculty of Computer Science at the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology.

explainer.lead: Yonatan Belinkov is a Computer scientist.

contributions.name: Belinkov also coauthored Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT, a 2022 NeurIPS paper that introduced Rank-One Model Editing, or ROME, a method for making targeted changes to factual associations in transformer language models without retraining the whole model.

timeline.what: He received a PhD in electrical engineering and computer science from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 2018.
He joined the Technion faculty in 2020 and is now an associate professor.
During the 2025–2026 academic year, Belinkov was a visiting scholar at Harvard's Kempner Institute.
